title: Gifted-kids program with ESP training from Miss Kaur
summary: Deep Prasad tells of Gifted-kids program with ESP training from Miss Kaur, about age 10 to 12 at Near Vancouver, British Columbia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And she got me to look into ESP, the psychic phenomenon.

plain: Deep Prasad, a technology researcher, says that around age 10 to 12, near Vancouver in Canada, he was in a program for gifted children run by a teacher he calls Miss Kaur. He says she got him to look into ESP, meaning psychic perception, and pointed him toward writers on hidden history such as an author named Jim Marrs. He tells it as the start of his interest in these questions.
